description.value: Tru Value Foods Quathiaski Cove is a community-oriented grocery store located just seconds from the Quadra Island/Campbell River ferry terminal, making it a natural first or last stop for cyclists arriving on or departing from the island. The store has an old-school market feel that its manager describes as complementing the character of the surrounding area. It is part of a small, independently minded BC island chain with locations on Pender, Mayne, and Quadra Island.

address.value: 658 Harper Road, Quadra Island, BC V0P 1N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is clearly active (weekly flyer dated May 27–June 1, 2026; community news from February 2026), confirming an open grocery store at 658 Harper Road, Quathiaski Cove, Quadra Island. The website consistently spells the business 'Tru Value Foods' rather than OSM's 'True Value Foods'; the OSM email domain 'truvaluefoods.com' corroborates the website spelling, so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, leaving those fields null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'True Value Foods' but the business website, email domain (truvaluefoods.com), and all branding consistently use 'Tru Value Foods'. OSM name appears to be a misspelling.
OSM opening_hours (09:00-19:00) do not match hours shown on the website (9am-8pm Mon-Sat, 9am-7pm Sun). OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible full-service grocery store at the Quadra Island ferry landing — a highly relevant resupply stop for touring cyclists.
